# LoDeCharlie MAD

> LoDeCharlie es un café de barrio con alma que abre en Madrid en 2026.

## About

LoDeCharlie MAD is a coffee shop launching in Madrid, Spain in 2026. The brand focuses on neighborhood warmth, quality coffee, and community.

## Status

Currently in pre-launch. A coming soon page is live at https://lodecharlie.com with a countdown to the opening and an email signup for early access.

## Location

Madrid, Spain (exact address to be announced).

## Opening

2026
